scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:chromium
scripts.release:firefox: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs firefox
scripts.release:chromium: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:chromium && node scripts/verify-build.mjs chromium
scripts.release:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && node scripts/verify-build.mjs all
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:all && npm run verify:build
scripts.package:firefox: node scripts/verify-build.mjs firefox && web-ext build --config web-ext-config.cjs --overwrite-dest && node scripts/verify-package.mjs
